title.narrative: Monitoring and joint activities for DRC WRM IPDF MF second round programme

description.narrative: This project is the completion of DRC267. CAFOD DRC is implementing the second round of the DFID Matching Funds WRM programme implemented in Goma and Bukavu as well beside the first round implemented in Goma and Dungu. The overall WASH programme includes partners’ grants and CAFOD costs. Implementing partners are CARITAS Goma and BDD-BUKAVU for the second round and CARITAS Dungu and CARITAS Goma of the first round. The first round will produce safe water and promote hygiene and sanitation, while the second will reduce water spillage, will stabilize the soil around the spring, will reinforce infiltration into the ground water table by planting trees on menaced fields, will diversify the water usage, will fight climate change and will fight the risk of contamination of water springs in the poorest and disadvantaged rural communities of Masisi and Kalehe by improving access to EFFICIENT WATER RESOURCES MANAGEMENT for at least 25,500 people (13,200 women and 12,240 men). The programme will mainstream gender and incorporate activities that will promote women. This PSGA is an internal grant to support joint activities during the programme implementation including: - Monitoring activities - Support partners in developing Gender Mainstreaming Policies and Implementing Strategies - Gender audit for 1 partner (BDD-Shabunda) - Mid-term review and evaluation These activities will benefit CAFOD’s programme staff, partners and beneficiary communities. The CAFOD WASH & Environment Programme Officer based in Goma will be responsible for the implementation of these activities under the supervision on the PM and the CR.
